Jwt.//SigningKey: Left blank on purpose. dotnet publish copies this file straight into the web root, so a key committed here would be published with it. Supply Jwt__SigningKey as an environment variable, or appsettings.Production.json. Blank means the Production startup check refuses to start - fail closed, not open.
Jwt.//ServiceSecret: Left blank on purpose. Supply it as the Jwt__ServiceSecret environment variable so it never sits in a file under the web root. Blank means POST /auth/service-token answers 401 - fail closed, not open.
